settings.heroSubheadline: Timeless Pakistani lawn, delicate chiffon, and heirloom embroidery tailored for modern grace.
settings.aboutUsContent:
Founded in Lahore with a deep reverence for Pakistani textile heritage, CHUNARIYA crafts women’s ensembles that balance artisanal embroidery with contemporary, wearable elegance.

Every collection—from breathable summer Swiss lawn to hand-finished formal chiffon—is thoughtfully designed in blush pinks, warm ivories, creams, and rich maroons accented with antique gold zari. Whether you prefer bespoke unstitched yardage or ready-to-wear silhouettes, our atelier delivers effortless luxury directly to your doorstep.
